messages.snippet: Dear all, The firm's document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 21 March
messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 21 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 21 March until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents beforehand. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
